Waiting areas and a calm session
The cargo lead recorded a question about handover notes, and the crew cheered

Quiet care, steady handovers

At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk kept the day moving with patient check-ins and clear desk updates. Staff stayed close to each animal in transit, watching for comfort cues and noting any service changes in the ledger so the next handoff stayed smooth. That steady routine helps travelers feel supported, and it gives the cabin team what they need to keep animals settled and cared for.

For families sending pets on their way, the message is simple: calm handling matters. From the first note to the final handover, the desk works to keep details in order and the experience reassuring. Every step is handled with care, and every animal gets thoughtful attention from trained staff.
